name: Lily Bay State Park

fees.note: $20 a night for a Maine resident, $30 for a non-resident. Fees are per site for up to 6 people. Reserving adds a non-refundable $5 processing fee for each night, not once per booking. 9% lodging tax on camping fees. Bureau of Parks and Lands fee schedule, read 2026-10-12 (the same table since at least April 2024).

source: https://www.maine.gov/dacf/parks/camping/reservations/campground_fees.shtml (Lily Bay row, read 2026-10-12; same table in Wayback captures of 2024-04-16, 2025-04-30 and 2026-05-28) + https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/public/index ('$5 per night processing fees'; online season 5/18-9/13/2026, so no 2027 night could be priced)
